entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Mughal Empire, a political institution in Uzbekistan during Timurid Empire and Samarkand Golden Age (1449–1507). Grew from Ulugh Beg and Timurid Renaissance and Timur defeats the Ottoman Sultan Bayezid I at the Battle of Ankara. Led to the emergence of Babur and Timurid Decline.
